newsitem.title: USA: ComEd sees Ill. Dresden 3 nuke up in Dec..
newsitem.headline: ComEd sees Ill. Dresden 3 nuke up in Dec..

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) planned to restore the 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 3 nuclear power plant to operation in December after being shut October 26 for maintenance, a company spokesman said Monday.
"We're looking at the second week of December," said the spokesman.
The adjoining Dresden 2 nuclear unit, also rated at 794 MW, was running at 81 percent of capacity, according to Nuclear Regulatory Commission's daily status report.
The Dresden units are in Morris, Ill.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
